visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A drummer with long dark hair, wearing a green hoodie and glasses, is seen playing a red drum set on an elevated stage. Behind him, a massive LED screen displays a live feed of women in blue sports uniforms, and a hand is visible touching a tablet UI overlaying the scene. (2) The camera angle shifts to the back of the stage, showing four band members from behind as they perform for a massive outdoor crowd at night. Bright stage lights illuminate the performers while the city skyline and buildings are visible in the far background. (3) A wide shot captures the audience from a low angle, showing hundreds of people holding up yellow glowing light sticks and smartphones. Beams of white light cut through the dark, hazy sky above the dense group of spectators. (4) A close-up shot of a young man with long, wavy black hair looking upwards toward the sky with an expression of deep emotion or awe. The background consists of blurry outdoor lights and trees. He slowly closes his eyes as if soaking in the atmosphere. (5) A cinematic cut displays a man in a blue shirt in a nightclub setting with saturated blue and red lighting. He moves his head slightly to the rhythm, looking pensive. Other figures are blurred in the background amidst colorful hanging decorations. (6) Two young adults, a male and a female, pose for a selfie-style shot in front of the concert crowd. They both smile and make peace signs with their hands. In the dark sky behind them, colorful fireworks explode over the illuminated city.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop-rock music begins immediately with a driving drum beat and bright electric guitar chords. A male vocalist sings in a passionate, high-pitched tone with significant intensity. The acoustic atmosphere is expansive, resembling a large outdoor concert venue. (2) The volume of the background music swells as the sound of a large crowd cheering and whistling becomes clearly audible in the background. The vocal delivery remains energetic, moving through a melodic progression with a fast tempo of approximately 140 BPM. (3) A series of deep, percussive thuds and sharp crackling sounds from fireworks are layered over the music. The spectral brightness increases, reflecting the high-frequency sizzle of the pyrotechnics. The blend of music, crowd noise, and explosions creates a very dense audio environment. (4) The music continues its upbeat rhythm while the crowd noise floor remains high. The male vocals reach a climactic high note before the track begins a slight fade-out toward the end. The final percussive crack of an explosion is heard before the audio cuts.
